scripts.dev: concurrently -k "npm run dev -w apps/server" "npm run dev -w apps/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/client && tsc -p apps/server/tsconfig.json
scripts.release:check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build && npm test && npm run security:scan && npm audit --audit-level=high
scripts.typecheck:browser: tsc --noEmit --target ES2022 --module ESNext --moduleResolution Bundler --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck playwright.config.ts tests/browser/*.spec.ts
